question: Kabir, Jasbir, Urmila, Richa, Prem, Deep and Sonika are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Sonika sits third to the right of Prem. Kabir sits to the immediate right of Deep. Jasbir sits second to the left of Sonika. Urmila sits third to the right of Jasbir. Who sits second to the left of Urmila?
solution:
Given:

Kabir, Jasbir, Urmila, Richa, Prem, Deep and Sonika are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre

Sonika sits third to the right of Prem. Jasbir sits second to the left of Sonika.

Urmila sits third to the right of Jasbir. 

Kabir sits to the immediate right of Deep. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78c5ce2bc5615ca730fd5e40300a4f1a86998c478516a6eb04fc4a519e03cdfc.png] 

Thus, Richa sits second to the left of Urmila.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
